title: Engineering workplace: read six useful words
description: Read common planning and engineering-workplace terms in hiragana; no lesson route or prerequisites.

review.provenance: Independently authored short workplace cues and explanations; common word spellings and meanings are linguistic facts, not legacy CSV or mock text.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-written prompts, translations, contexts and explanations; no copied text, audio or third-party assets.

exercises.prompt: In a team's calendar, read this event and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: A team meeting appears on the calendar.

text.context: A team meeting appears on the calendar.

exercises.explanation: 会議 is read かいぎ and means meeting; it can be a scheduled team discussion.

exercises.prompt: In a meeting invitation, read this word for accompanying documents and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Share the reference materials before a meeting.

text.context: Share the reference materials before a meeting.

exercises.explanation: 資料 is read しりょう: materials or reference documents for a meeting. The ょ is small.

exercises.prompt: On a project calendar, read this word for plans and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Check the plan for next week.

text.context: Check the plan for next week.

exercises.explanation: 予定 is read よてい: a plan or scheduled event, as on a project calendar.

exercises.prompt: In a message asking you to get in touch, read this noun and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Send a message to keep a teammate informed.

text.context: Send a message to keep a teammate informed.

exercises.explanation: 連絡 is read れんらく and means contact or communication; it can refer to getting in touch with a colleague.

exercises.prompt: Before sending a change, read this word for checking and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Check the details before sending a change.

text.context: Check the details before sending a change.

exercises.explanation: 確認 is read かくにん: confirmation or checking of details before a change.

exercises.prompt: In an engineering project update, read this activity and type its reading in hiragana.

stimulus.context: Discuss software development with the team.

text.context: Discuss software development with the team.

exercises.explanation: 開発 is read かいはつ and means development; here it refers to a software project.
